title: The server is Zoetrope and the viewer apps are Praxi, once the names are cleared
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need."; "Installing is boring.". The owner chose Zoetrope (server) and Praxi (viewer apps, Octave's successor), after the early moving-picture devices, as the convention for all of the project's software (D-122). Nothing is renamed until the names are cleared. Renaming the GitHub organisation and setting its logo are the owner's, in the web interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate: a name check is recorded in docs/ (no personal data): for each name, a trademark search in the registers of the owner's market for software and streaming services, and a search for video or streaming software of the same name, each with its findings and a verdict. The owner approves the result before anything else in this task starts; a name that fails returns to the owner.

An operator meets Zoetrope everywhere they meet the server: the image, the binary, the configuration and environment names, the logs, the metrics and the docs. The release notes name every name an operator must change.

An operator upgrading from the last jellyscale release keeps their data and goes on with the documented steps; an old configuration or environment name is either still read or refused at start with the new name in the message, never silently ignored.
The image is published under its new name and the old name's last tag stays available, so Octave's CI and the dogfood keep working; Octave is told on its issue.
PRODUCT.md, AGENTS.md, DOMAINS.md, the docs and the contract (JS-183) use the new names, and the repository is renamed.
No viewer-visible change but the name.
notes: If the gate is not met when this is next, JS-198 goes first and this task follows it, renaming the image once. Dropped at the native-client plan (D-129 to D-149): The name stays jellyscale and the apps stay Octave (D-129): no rename and no name check.
